recap.text: Warlord Akuma says Menerva and Herot built the Pineapple Cabaret and a pocket dimension for mobs and NPCs. Akuma says they are forgotten and trapped by design. Mordecai and Rosetta use a shop interface and cleaner bots to find Menerva on the seventeenth floor, where she leads the NPCs in a maze.

beats.headline: A name inside somebody else's account
beats.text: The name arrives second-hand, in Warlord Akuma's account of who built the Pineapple Cabaret. Two former crawlers: Herot, and Menerva. They were given the seventeenth floor to build, and behind it they made a pocket dimension for mobs and NPCs to escape into, a thing of the same sort as the Nothing; by his telling the pair of them are forgotten down there, trapped by design. That is the whole of what he offers about her, and Akuma is not a careless speaker. The brevity is a choice. I have nothing in my own files to put beside it, which is itself worth writing down.
beats.gist: Warlord Akuma names Menerva and Herot as former crawlers who built a pocket dimension.

beats.headline: She is on the seventeenth floor
beats.text: The plan Mordecai and Rosetta are working on runs through a shop interface and a standing order for cleaner bots, and it puts the two builders in different places. Herot is in the cabaret. Menerva is on the seventeenth floor, in charge of the NPCs building and occupying the maze there. Nobody in that room has been within seven floors of the seventeenth, and this crawl is presently on the tenth. I hold a very great many records. I am not going to tell you which of them account for that.
beats.gist: Mordecai and Rosetta place Herot in the cabaret and Menerva on the seventeenth floor.
